notes.title: University Life Fix Update (April 20th 2023)
notes.content:
[b]University Life Update Fixes[/b]


• Fixing sexual scene with Kate.
• Fixing Britt scene when walking away interaction.
• Fixing grain from some pictures.
• Fixing sexual scene with Daisy
• Taking away the animation that was made and putting in a picture to picture. 
• When name changes to (Alex) fix.
• Dialog Update

[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
University Life will have Achievements! We will be adding achievements! 

I saw some people requesting achievements and it's being worked on! 

[b]Fixing Kate Model[/b]

As been pointed out that Kate has random spots on her head. Came to find out it was a hair glitch that was happening with the hair. 
We have updated her hair now. Same colour but different hair. The different hair will be put in the next story update. 
For the rest of the story her old hair will be there until the next update.

[b]Fixing Sexual Scenes With Kate/Daisy[/b]

As we always view everything that the players have said we had one person point out that Kate's sex scene at the beginning was Grey. Also sexual scenes were not long enough. So, we are going to make the Kate scene longer and with more sexual interactions that [b]You the player[/b] get's to choose.

Daisy sex scene will also be updated with choices for the player to choose. With Anal choice or a blow job choice! 

[b]Fixing Britt scene when walking away interaction.[/b]

Fixing the choice of watching Britt or walking away choice. This will be also be fixed in the update. As there is no walking away from the door picture. We want to thank the players who have pointed this out on steam on and discord. 

[b]Fixing grain from some pictures.[/b]

With the new update we will try to fix most of the grain in the pictures. We do apologize for that and hope to have that fixed asap. 




[b]Taking away the animation that was made and putting in a picture to picture.[/b]

Reason towards taking off the Animation is because my computer cannot handle the rendering for the animations. But does well with the pictures. So I will be taking away the Animation until I get new components for my computer. I hope that will be soon.

[b]Dialog Update[/b]

•Dialog will be updated for University Life. To bring more into the story and to make the story shine. 


 [b]Thank you.[/b]

We want to thank everyone for the feedback about University Life. As University Life is under beta there will be a lot of updates to go by. With your feedback is helping us to make University Life better then before. ♥
